mapper.select: SELECT o.*, a.receiver_name, a.receiver_phone, CONCAT(a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address) as full_address FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_address a ON o.address_id = a.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.id DESC

SELECT o.*, a.receiver_name, a.receiver_phone, CONCAT(a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address) as full_address FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_address a ON o.address_id = a.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, a.receiver_name, a.receiver_phone, CONCAT(a.province, a.city, a.district, a.detailed_address) as full_address FROM t_order o LEFT JOIN t_address a ON o.address_id = a.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, user_id, address_id, total_amount, status, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{addressId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
